item.title: Petal 1.0.0
item.description:
## Petal 1.0.0
- Drag any file to bloom the ring: convert, compress, resize, edit, crop, annotate, redact. - PDF tools: merge files, organize pages (reorder, rotate, delete, extract) and split by page, every N pages or custom ranges. - Control panel in the menu bar, plus Workspace, History and Settings in the Manager. - Automatic updates.
